settings.title: Forwarding settings · {{name}}
settings.desc: Only the access point configuration is stored here; the provider's name, type and key are unaffected.
settings.slug_hint: Letters, digits and - _ . only, starting with a letter or digit, at most 64 characters. It only appears in the dedicated address, so changing it changes the address.
settings.slug_off_hint: Turning forwarding off keeps the address: known endpoints still load-balance across all providers, only unknown paths stop being forwarded.
settings.slug_change_warning: The slug changed: the old address stops working on save and every client using it must be updated.
settings.address_preview_empty: Enter a valid slug to see the full address
settings.address_preview_hint: Clients put this in base_url; they append the concrete path themselves.
settings.protocol_hint_openai: OpenAI-compatible: clients append /chat/completions and friends, so the base address ends with /v1.
settings.protocol_hint_anthropic: Anthropic: the SDK appends /v1/messages itself, so the base address must not end with /v1.
settings.protocol_hint_gemini: Gemini: clients append /models/{model}:generateContent, so the base address ends with /v1beta.
settings.mode_hint: Applies to the dedicated address only; unknown paths on the regular /v1 address always return 404.
settings.mode_off_desc: Only known endpoints work on the dedicated address; everything else returns 404.
settings.mode_mixed_desc: Known endpoints still load-balance across all providers; unknown paths go to this provider.
settings.mode_pure_desc: Every request (including known endpoints) goes to this provider; requires a key with full model permission.
settings.rewrite_hint: Whether to replace the model name in forwarded requests with one this provider understands.
settings.rewrite_none_desc: Forward as-is; clients must use the upstream model name directly (embedding paths stay untouched too).
settings.rewrite_known_desc: Rewrite to the upstream model name only when the model exists and is bound to this provider; leave unknown names as-is.
settings.rewrite_all_desc: Always replace the model name with a fixed target; Gemini model names in the path are replaced too.
settings.target_hint: Every forwarded request uses this upstream model name; when the target contains /, : or spaces only the body is rewritten, not the path.
settings.target_required: Full rewrite requires a target model
settings.slug_required: An address slug is required unless forwarding is off
settings.slug_invalid: Invalid slug: letters, digits and - _ . only, starting with a letter or digit, at most 64 characters

guide.title: How forwarding works
guide.intro: In pure forwarding mode, one dedicated address points at a single provider: use that address and the provider's native model names just work. With forwarding off or mixed, known endpoints still load-balance across all providers. Five short sections and you're set.
guide.address_desc: Address = {{origin}} + /p/ + your slug, and the suffix depends on the protocol. Clients only need the base address:
guide.address_table_caption: Address and client path per protocol
guide.address_note: The current host is {{origin}}. A different domain or reverse-proxy path changes the address, not the slug.
guide.mode_off: Only known endpoints such as chat/completions work on the dedicated address; anything else returns 404. Useful when you only want address isolation without forwarding unknown endpoints.
guide.mode_mixed: Known endpoints still load-balance across all providers; only unknown paths are forwarded to this provider. Useful for experimental endpoints on this provider without disturbing regular chat traffic.
guide.mode_pure: Every request, including known endpoints like /v1/chat/completions, goes to this provider and skips load balancing. Useful when this system acts as a passthrough proxy for one upstream.
guide.rewrite_none: Model names are forwarded as-is. Clients must use the provider's upstream model names; paths like embedding are never rewritten.
guide.rewrite_known: Only models that exist in the system and are bound to this provider are rewritten to the upstream model name; unknown names are forwarded as-is. Default and backward compatible.
guide.rewrite_all: Every request's model name is replaced with one fixed target model (Gemini model names in the path too); requires a key with full model permission.
guide.auth_desc: The dedicated address still needs an access key, sent in the header for OpenAI/Anthropic/Gemini. Requests with a model are checked against model permission; requests without a model, full-rewrite requests and pure-forwarding requests all require a key with full model permission.
guide.pitfall_1: "Off" does not disable the address: known endpoints still load-balance across all providers; only unknown paths stop being forwarded.
guide.pitfall_2: The Anthropic base address must not end with /v1: the SDK appends /v1/messages itself, so you would get /v1/v1/messages.
guide.pitfall_3: Changing the slug invalidates the old address immediately; rename the provider freely — the address only depends on the slug.
